## Where SNPs are in the genes?

```{r}
library(biomaRt)

library(biomaRt)
library(data.table)

mart <- useMart("plants_mart", 
                dataset = "athaliana_eg_gene",
                host = "https://plants.ensembl.org")

regions <- paste0("5:", candidate_genes_chr5$ps - 1, ":", candidate_genes_chr5$ps + 1)

exon_info <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name", 
                 "exon_chrom_start", "exon_chrom_end",
                 "5_utr_start", "5_utr_end",
                 "3_utr_start", "3_utr_end"),
  filters = "chromosomal_region",
  values = list(regions),
  mart = mart
)

# For each SNP, determine where it falls
result <- candidate_genes_chr5 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(feature = {
    gene_ex <- exon_info[exon_info$ensembl_gene_id == gene_id, ]
    case_when(
      any(ps >= gene_ex$`5_utr_start` & ps <= gene_ex$`5_utr_end`, na.rm=TRUE) ~ "5_UTR",
      any(ps >= gene_ex$`3_utr_start` & ps <= gene_ex$`3_utr_end`, na.rm=TRUE) ~ "3_UTR",
      any(ps >= gene_ex$exon_chrom_start & ps <= gene_ex$exon_chrom_end, na.rm=TRUE) ~ "exon",
      TRUE ~ "intron"
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, rs, ps, feature)

print(result)
```

## SNPs of interest analysis
```{r}
snps_of_interest <- res_selected[
  res_selected$BP > 842289 & res_selected$BP < 845454, ]
snps_of_interest$P <- -log10(snps_of_interest$P)
## Add beta for each SNP 
```

```{r}
library(vcfR)
library(tidyverse)
vcf <- read.vcfR("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/chr5_847439_plusmin100k/AT5G03440.vcf")

# Extract genotype matrix (0/0, 0/1, 1/0,1/1 → 0, 1,1, 2)
geno <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT", as.numeric = FALSE)

# Convert to dosage (0/0=0, 0/1=1, 1/1=2)
geno_dosage <- apply(geno, 2, function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "0/0" ~ 0,
    x %in% c("0/1", "1/0") ~ 1,
    x == "1/1" ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
})

rownames(geno_dosage) <- paste0(vcf@fix[,"CHROM"], "_", vcf@fix[,"POS"])
geno_dosage <- t(geno_dosage)  
```

```{r}
# Load phenotype
pheno <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blup_overall_ddm1_average/rank_transform/1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected.fam", header = FALSE)

pheno <- pheno %>% dplyr::select(V2,V6)
######
#####
colnames(pheno) <- c("individual_id", "phenotype")
# Match individuals
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(geno_dosage), pheno$individual_id)
geno_sub <- geno_dosage[common_ids, ]
pheno_sub <- pheno[pheno$individual_id %in% common_ids, ]

# Linear model for each SNP
# Align by individual ID
pheno_sub <- pheno_sub[match(rownames(geno_sub), pheno_sub$individual_id), ]
# Verify alignment
all(rownames(geno_sub) == pheno_sub$individual_id)  # must be TRUE before proceeding

# Then run the models
results <- lapply(colnames(geno_sub), function(snp) {
  df <- data.frame(geno = geno_sub[, snp], phenotype = pheno_sub$phenotype)
  df <- na.omit(df)
  if (length(unique(df$geno)) < 2) return(data.frame(SNP = snp, R2 = NA))
  tryCatch({
    fit <- lm(phenotype ~ geno, data = df)
    data.frame(SNP = snp, R2 = summary(fit)$r.squared)
  }, error = function(e) data.frame(SNP = snp, R2 = NA))
})

results_df <- na.omit(do.call(rbind, results))
results_df[order(results_df$R2, decreasing = TRUE), ]


```


```{r}

# Step 2: Merge GWAS p-value into results_df
results_df_clean <- results_df %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  left_join(snps_of_interest %>% dplyr::select(SNP_clean, P_gwas = P), 
            by = c("SNP" = "SNP_clean")) %>%
  mutate(POS = as.numeric(gsub("Chr5_", "", SNP)),
         log10P_gwas = P_gwas)  # already -log10 from GEMMA

# Step 3: Plot R2 colored by GWAS -log10(P)
ggplot(results_df_clean, aes(x = POS, y = R2, 
                              color = log10P_gwas, 
                              size = log10P_gwas)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "steelblue", high = "#C00000",
                       name = expression(-log[10](P[GWAS]))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6), guide = "none") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(x = "Chr5 Position", y = expression(R^2),
       title = "SNP R² vs phenotype, colored by GWAS significance") +
  geom_text(data = results_df_clean[results_df_clean$R2 > 0.08, ],
            aes(label = SNP), size = 3, vjust = -1, color = "black")
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)

top2_snps <- results_df_clean %>%
  arrange(desc(log10P_gwas)) %>%
  slice(1:2) %>%
  pull(SNP)

plots <- lapply(top2_snps, function(snp) {
  
  # Prepare data
  df_plot <- data.frame(
    geno = geno_sub[, snp],
    phenotype = pheno_sub$phenotype
  ) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    mutate(geno_label = factor(case_when(
      geno == 0 ~ "ref/ref",
      geno == 1 ~ "ref/alt",
      geno == 2 ~ "alt/alt"
    ), levels = c("ref/ref", "ref/alt", "alt/alt")))
  
  # Only compare groups that exist
  existing <- levels(droplevels(df_plot$geno_label))
  comparisons <- Filter(function(x) all(x %in% existing),
                        list(c("ref/ref", "ref/alt"),
                             c("ref/ref", "alt/alt"),
                             c("ref/alt", "alt/alt")))
  
  # Labels
  r2   <- round(results_df_clean$R2[results_df_clean$SNP == snp], 4)
  pval <- formatC(results_df_clean$P[results_df_clean$SNP == snp], format = "e", digits = 2)
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = geno_label, y = phenotype, fill = geno_label)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.05, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons, method = "t.test", 
                       label = "p.signif", bracket.size = 0.4) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "anova", label = "p.format",
                       label.y = max(df_plot$phenotype) * 1.3, size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4472C4", "#ED7D31", "#C00000")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    labs(x = "Genotype", y = "log2(TPM)",
         title = snp,
         subtitle = paste0("R² = ", r2, "")) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
})

plots[[1]] | plots[[2]]
```
## Connect to real TPMs  
```{r}
long_data_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_selected_raw_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_sene_long_data.csv")
long_data_anti_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_selected_raw_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_anti_sense_long_data.csv")
# attach strand
long_data_sense$strand <-"+"
long_data_anti_sense$strand <-"-"
# Combine dataframe
long_data_anti_sense2 <- long_data_anti_sense %>%
  mutate(TE = gsub("_AS$", "", TE))

# TEs unique to each direction
sense_only_TEs <- setdiff(long_data_sense$TE, long_data_anti_sense$TE)
anti_only_TEs  <- setdiff(long_data_anti_sense2$TE, long_data_sense$TE)
# Filter and combine
long_data_combined <- bind_rows(
  long_data_sense %>% filter(TE %in% sense_only_TEs),
  long_data_anti_sense2 %>% filter(TE %in% anti_only_TEs)
)
# All TEs, not only unique 
long_data_combined_all <- rbind(long_data_sense,long_data_anti_sense)
```
## Connect TPM values to the genotype 
```{r}
long_data_combined_all <- long_data_combined_all %>%
  select(TE, expression_value, genotype, accession, replicate) %>%
  filter(genotype == "ddm1") %>%
  group_by(accession) %>%                          
  dplyr::summarise(phenotype = mean(log2(expression_value + 1)), .groups = "drop")
```

## WHAT is the gene structure?
```{r}
library(biomaRt)
mart <- useMart("plants_mart", 
                dataset = "athaliana_eg_gene",
                host = "https://plants.ensembl.org")

# Get gene structure around your SNPs
gene_info <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name", 
                 "chromosome_name", "start_position", "end_position",
                 "strand", "gene_biotype"),
  filters = c("chromosomal_region"),
  values = list("5:842289:845454"),  # your region
  mart = mart
)

```

```{r}
library(biomaRt)
library(Gviz)
library(GenomicRanges)

mart <- useMart("plants_mart", 
                dataset = "athaliana_eg_gene",
                host = "https://plants.ensembl.org")

# Step 1: Get transcript/exon structure
exon_info <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "ensembl_transcript_id", "external_gene_name",
                 "chromosome_name", "exon_chrom_start", "exon_chrom_end",
                 "rank", "strand", "5_utr_start", "5_utr_end",
                 "3_utr_start", "3_utr_end"),
  filters = c("chromosomal_region"),
  values = list("5:842289:845454"),
  mart = mart
)


```

```{r}
library(Gviz)
library(GenomicRanges)

gene_start <- min(exon_info$exon_chrom_start) - 1000
gene_end   <- max(exon_info$exon_chrom_end) + 1000

# Axis
gtrack <- GenomeAxisTrack()

# Gene structure
gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames   = "5",
  ranges     = IRanges(start = exon_info$exon_chrom_start,
                       end   = exon_info$exon_chrom_end),
  strand     = "+",
  transcript = exon_info$ensembl_transcript_id,
  gene       = exon_info$external_gene_name,
  exon       = paste0("exon", exon_info$rank),
  feature    = "protein_coding"
)

grtrack <- GeneRegionTrack(gr, 
                           name = "DPB",
                           col = "black", fill = "grey80",
                           transcriptAnnotation = "transcript")

# SNPs
snp_track <- AnnotationTrack(
  GRanges("5", IRanges(c(842795, 844294), c(842795, 844294))),
  name = "SNPs",
  id   = c("Chr5_842795", "Chr5_844294"),
  col  = "red", fill = "red",
  featureAnnotation = "id",
  fontcolor.feature = "red",
  cex.feature = 0.7
)

# Plot
plotTracks(list(gtrack, grtrack, snp_track),
           chromosome = "5",
           from = gene_start, to = gene_end,
           background.title = "white",
           col.title = "black",
           col.axis = "black")
```
## How expression of DDM1 is correlated with phenotype?
```{r}
ddm1_expression <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_individual_genes/ddm1/AT5G66740/1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected.fam")
ddm1_expression <- ddm1_expression %>% select(V2,V6)
colnames(ddm1_expression) <- c("accession", "phenotype")
ddm1_expression_with_tpms <- inner_join(ddm1_expression,long_data_combined_all, by=c("accession"), suffix=c("_ddm1", "_te_tpm") )

ggplot(ddm1_expression_with_tpms, aes(phenotype_ddm1,phenotype_te_tpm))+geom_point()

cor_test <- cor.test(ddm1_expression_with_tpms$phenotype_ddm1, 
                     ddm1_expression_with_tpms$phenotype_te_tpm)

ggplot(ddm1_expression_with_tpms, aes(phenotype_ddm1, phenotype_te_tpm)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 3), 
                          "  p = ", formatC(cor_test$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2))) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "DDM1 TPM F1 ddm1", y = "TE TPM F1 ddm1")
```
